name: Corporate Sector Identifier 1 Code
definition: Identifies the corporate sector of the counterparty for reporting to trade repositories.

L.name: Alternative Investment Fund
L.definition: Alternative investment fund managed by an Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) authorised or registered in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2011/61/EU.

A.name: Assurance
A.definition: Assurance undertaking authorised in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2002/83/EC.

C.name: Credit Institution
C.definition: Credit Institution authorised in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2006/48/EC.

I.name: Insurance
I.definition: Insurance undertaking in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 73/239/EEC.

F.name: Investment Firm
F.definition: Investment firm in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2004/39/EC.

O.name: Occupational Retirement Provision
O.definition: Institution for occupational retirement provision within the meaning of Article 6(a) of European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2003/41/EC.

R.name: Reinsurance
R.definition: Reinsurance undertaking authorised in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2005/68/EC.

U.name: UCITS
U.definition: Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) and its management company, authorised in accordance with European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Directive 2009/95/EC.
